data.gender_notes: Sakir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sakir is a Sanskrit word that means 'guardian' or 'protector'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sak', which means 'friend' or 'ally'. It is believed that a child named Sakir will grow up to be a strong and courageous individual, who will be a source of protection and support for those around him. The name also suggests a deep sense of intelligence and wisdom.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, the name Sakir is associated with the deity Shiva, who is known as the protector of the universe. A child named Sakir is believed to carry the divine qualities of Shiva, such as strength, courage, and wisdom. This name is also believed to bring good fortune and protection to the child and his family.
data.etymology: Sakir belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sakir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
